name: Apache County, AZ
findings: Apache County has 33 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Apache County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
75% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Apache County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 70% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
